name: BG.IBELICK
summary: Copy-paste background snippets for web pages, each in Tailwind CSS and vanilla CSS with a live preview.
description: A collection of modern background snippets you copy into a project. Each snippet has a live preview and a copy-code button, with Tailwind CSS and vanilla CSS versions, and is made for full-page backgrounds that you tweak to fit.
contains: background snippets with live preview and copy code
Tailwind CSS and vanilla CSS versions
